castTime.binNote: Wiki lists cast time by rank as 0.4 to 0.25 (5 values); bin gives a single castTime of 0.35 with no per-rank array. Recording the bin's single value here since the field requires a number; the two sources disagree on both the value and whether it scales by rank.

mechanics.claim: The laser fires in a line and hits multiple enemies (AoE).
mechanics.quote: fires a laser in a line in the direction of the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: Piercing Light can be blocked by spell shields.
The ability leads a moving target during the cast but does not adjust after the cast time begins, so the target can dodge by moving enough.
mechanics.quote: will attempt to lead the target if it is moving but does not adjust further during the cast time (enemies can dodge the laser if they change their position by a sufficient amount during the cast time)

mechanics.claim: Lucian can buffer W or R during Q's cast time, but not E.
mechanics.quote: '''Lucian''' can buffer {{ai|W|Lucian}} or {{ai|R|Lucian}} during the cast time. {{ai|E|Lucian}} is locked out.

mechanics.claim: The cast time ends prematurely if the initial target dies, letting Lucian act freely sooner.
mechanics.quote: Piercing Light's cast time ends prematurely if the initial target dies, allowing '''Lucian''' to attack and move freely, or to immediately begin casting either {{ai|W|Lucian}} or {{ai|R|Lucian}}
